contract.title: TWIN-46 921600全栈配置化启动与MC/TH Debug↔Web UI双向链路对账集成验证
contract.accepted_scope: Software, sim-mode lifecycle, and 921600 PTY virtual-MCU hardware-mode full-stack integration verification of debug_reconciliation_probe.py across the 5 telemetry/control categories (temperature, motion/homing, 5x5 bed-leveling grid, filament/slot, job state), unit-specific offline sentinel (2147483646 mdeg / 32767 ddC) and strict HTTP 503 lock checks, live negative fault injection and live recovery loop against the running ui-gateway, and deploy_twin.sh lifecycle. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

消费TWIN-44 MC固件USART2 921600与USART1非阻塞[MC-DBG]日志固件产物
消费TWIN-45 TH固件USART3非阻塞[TH-DBG]日志固件产物

positive_cases: debug_reconciliation_probe.py同步解析真实[MC-DBG]与[TH-DBG]结构化串口日志流及AP HTTP/SSE状态快照（支持--self-test、--mc-log/--th-log/--ap-snapshot离线对账及--ap-url配合--mc-log/--th-log在线拉取运行中ui-gateway实时快照与SSE流，不伪造日志或回退默认快照），自动生成五类核心业务（温度、归零/移动、二维5x5调平网格、进退丝/料槽、打印作业状态）双向对账报告(--matrix-out)
全栈一键启动脚本deploy_twin.sh在921600默认配置下完成编译、sim模式启停探活，并通过921600 POSIX PTY连接运行态全栈完成在线五类正向对账、在线故障注入、在线恢复与优雅停止闭环
negative_cases: 当[MC-DBG]/[TH-DBG]日志中的五类业务状态与AP/UI状态快照不一致、调平网格非严格5x5二维列表（如1x25畸形网格）、或出现未预期的CRC_ERR/TIMEOUT/BAD_FRAME/TX_ERR或drop>0/trunc>0时，debug_reconciliation_probe.py在离线与--ap-url在线模式下均返回非0退出码并定位失配项；恢复一致快照与正常日志流后重新对账返回0

当处于业务串口断连/离线状态（system_status=OFFLINE）时，debug_reconciliation_probe.py按单位严格校验AP温度哨兵值（2147483646毫摄氏度）与MCU日志/deci-C温度哨兵值（32767十分之一摄氏度）及ui-gateway控制接口严格HTTP 503锁定响应（拒绝错误单位哨兵值及504/200状态码），并在运行态网关恢复ONLINE后在线对账恢复通过
